summary.excerpt: Joshua is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. He is the commander of the 30th Division of the Demon Slayers, the Order of Light.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Joshua is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. He is the commander of the 30th Division of the Demon Slayers, the Order of Light.

sections.title: In Brave Frontier I
sections.content: As part of the Battles of Brave Frontier 2 series, Joshua can be fought in The Silver Knight. The fight serves as a reference to how players can challenge Joshua in Trial No. 3 in Brave Frontier II.
